title: Vote on a compact answer
summary: Count exact compact answers using a strict majority.
useWhen: The output is one exact, narrow answer.
Each candidate has independent supporting evidence.
avoidWhen: The output is code, architecture or a preference.
contract: Require a nonempty single-line answer of at most 256 characters.
A strict majority is required; ties stay unresolved.
example: Compare independently derived exact identifiers, then verify the majority identifier against the primary source.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Exact answers] --> M{Strict majority?}
  M -->|Yes| V[Verify answer]
  M -->|No| U[Unresolved]
